data.body_html:
Feria San Bernabé 2027 is Marbella’s biggest summer festival — four days of flamenco, rebujito, casetas, and fireworks from 11 to 14 June. But the party doesn’t have to stay on land. A Feria San Bernabé 2027 boat party lets you trade the crowded fairground for the Mediterranean, with cold cava, a private deck, and views of the Sierra Blanca. Here’s everything you need to plan your yacht charter from Puerto Banús.

Why a boat party during Feria San Bernabé?

Marbella’s Feria is loud, hot, and packed. A boat party offers a calm escape without leaving the fiesta vibe. You get:

  • Your own music, drinks, and space — no queues.
  • Swim stops at Cala del Faro or Cabopino beach.
  • Sunset views over La Concha from the water.
  • Easy access back to the fairground (Puerto Banús is a 10-min taxi ride from the Recinto Ferial).

It works as a pre-fair warm-up (2-hour charter from €749) or an all-day escape (8-hour charter from €2,299).

Our Feria-ready fleet from Puerto Banús

All our boats depart from Puerto Banús, 6 km from the Marbella fairground. Here are the best options for a Feria boat party:

All charters include a licensed skipper, fuel, drinks (water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava), light snacks, insurance, and 21% IVA. No hidden costs.

How to plan your Feria San Bernabé 2027 boat party

1. Pick your time slot

Most Feria boat parties run midday to sunset (12:00–20:00). A 4-hour charter (€1,499–€4,719 depending on boat) gives you time for a swim stop, lunch, and a cruise past the Marbella coastline. For fireworks on Saturday 12 June, book a 6-hour or 8-hour charter to stay out until 23:00.

2. Choose your route

From Puerto Banús, typical itineraries include:

  • West: Puerto Banús → Cabopino → Cala del Faro → Marbella Marina (2–3 hours round trip).
  • East: Puerto Banús → Río Verde → Cala Cortés → Estepona coast (3–4 hours).
  • Fireworks route: Anchor 300 m off Marbella beach near the fairground (skipper will position for best view).

3. Book early

Feria week is peak season. Our fleet has 16 boats, but the Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39) sell out first. Contact us via WhatsApp for real-time availability. We recommend booking at least 2–3 weeks in advance.

What’s included in your charter

Every boat party includes:

  • Licensed skipper (English and Spanish speaking).
  • Fuel for the full charter duration.
  • Water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, and cava (chilled).
  • Light snacks (olives, crisps, nuts).
  • Insurance and safety equipment.
  • 21% Spanish IVA (VAT) — no surprises.

You can bring extra food or drinks. Glass bottles are discouraged on smaller boats, but plastic or cans are fine. Let the skipper know if you want a catered menu (available on request for larger yachts like the Ferretti 94).

Feria fireworks from the water

The Saturday night fireworks (12 June 2027) are launched from the beach near Marbella’s promenade, visible from the sea. Our skippers will anchor 200–300 metres offshore — close enough to feel the bass, far enough to avoid the crowd. Bring a bluetooth speaker, pour a glass of cava, and watch the sky light up over La Concha. This is the best seat in Marbella.

What to wear and bring

  • Swimwear and a towel (swim stops are included).
  • Sunscreen (SPF 50+ — June sun is strong).
  • A light jacket or jumper (evening breeze on the water).
  • Non-slip shoes (no black-soled shoes on deck).
  • Your own playlist (most boats have Bluetooth/AUX).
  • Cash for tips (optional, but appreciated).
